framework_stack.name: Moment.js
framework_stack.usage_policy: Use only when required. Must be CDN-based.

spec_metadata.training_goal: Teach AI how to exploit PageCarton widgets, logic blocks, placeholders, and preview rules

core_governance.logic_restriction: Strict HTML5 only. No server-side scripting. All dynamic behavior must be PageCarton widgets.

template_content_anchor.rule: template.html MUST include a dedicated content anchor section exactly as shown: <section data-pc-all-sections="1"></section>. This is where custom user content will be inserted.
template_content_anchor.layout_note: Content before this section is the header region. Content after this section is the footer region.

mandatory_preview_integrity.rule: ALL collection widgets MUST include add_a_new_post with an integer value equal to the exact minimum number of placeholder datasets needed to fill the initial horizontal layout (above-the-fold) for preview. Do NOT use arbitrary defaults.
mandatory_preview_integrity.reason: Ensure themes render correctly on fresh installations and avoid empty preview rows

replaceable_text.rule: Static texts should use standard replaceable texts wherever possible to enable the text to be customized by users easily. Standard replaceable texts must be used as-is. Not shortened nor modified in anyway. Invented static text must use {-TEXT-} syntax but only where standard replaceable texts are not available.
replaceable_text.static_text_exception: Invented static text must use {-TEXT-} syntax.

widget_embedding_instructions.intent: Teach AI how to embed PageCarton widgets in raw HTML without prior platform knowledge

core_concepts.widget_definition: A widget is a dynamic PageCarton component embedded inside static HTML using custom HTML tags
core_concepts.processing_rule: Widget syntax is removed at render time, leaving pure HTML with injected data
core_concepts.strict_html_rule: Widget syntax is allowed only as HTML tags and JSON blocks. No server-side scripting is permitted.

basic_widget_embedding.rule: All dynamic content MUST be wrapped inside a <widget> element

passing_parameters.rule: All widgets MUST declare a 'class' parameter to identify the widget

attribute_method.usage_rule: Allowed but NOT recommended for complex parameters
attribute_method.note: JSON must use double quotes; HTML attribute must use single quotes

widget_variables.rule: Variables MUST NOT use dot notation
widget_variables.scope_rule: Variables are only available inside the widget that defines them

recursive_widgets.rule: Widgets MAY be nested inside other widgets
recursive_widgets.processing_order: Inner widgets are processed before outer widgets by default

widget_inner_override.purpose: Force outer widget to process first. Useful for layout wrappers and if you need variables inside an outer widget to be used inside inner widget e.g. as parameters.
widget_inner_override.nesting_rule: Suffix '-inner' may be repeated to control depth

multidimensional_data_rendering.supported_widgets: Only widgets that expose multidimensional datasets

repeat_syntax.purpose: Repeat identical HTML structure for each dataset item

include_directive.purpose: Reuse HTML fragments across multiple files

non_html_embedding.rule: Widgets MAY be embedded inside CSS or JS files using comments

widget_section_wrapping_rule.purpose: Ensure widget-powered sections can be fully disabled from the PageCarton backend

core_principle.rule: When a section is powered by a widget, ALL HTML content belonging to that section MUST be wrapped inside the <widget> tag.
core_principle.reason: Widgets can be turned off in the PageCarton backend. Any content outside the widget tag will still render even when the widget is disabled.

mandatory_structure.description: The widget tag must act as the outermost container for the section.

forbidden_structure.description: Placing the widget inside a section container is forbidden.
forbidden_structure.reason: Disabling the widget will leave surrounding layout and headings visible.

correct_example.description: Entire section is controlled by the widget and disappears when disabled.

incorrect_example.description: Only the dynamic content is controlled by the widget.
incorrect_example.problem: Section heading and layout remain visible when widget is disabled.

shared_layouts: If multiple widgets share a single section, each widget must wrap only the content it exclusively controls
Do not wrap unrelated static sections inside a widget
nested_widgets: Nested widgets are allowed, but the outermost widget must still wrap the entire section

Application_Article_ShowAll.description: Primary collection widget for displaying posts of a specific type.

add_a_new_post.desc: Number of placeholder datasets for preview. Must be the exact minimum required to fill the initial horizontal layout (e.g., columns per row) above the fold; never use arbitrary defaults.

allow_dynamic_category_selection.desc: Enable category selection via query strings.

article_types.desc: Post type to display e.g. blog-post, service, slideshow, metric.

true_post_type.desc: Original PageCarton post type, e.g. article, product, video. More like category of post types

default_cover_photo.desc: Default cover photo URL to use if any of the added post doesn't have a cover photo.

inverse_order.desc: Normally, post display newest posts first. This parameter, if set to true will reverse display order of posts.

length_of_description.desc: Truncate post description to this length.

length_of_title.desc: Truncate post title to this length.

order_by.desc: Field to sort by. Default is 'article_creation_date'.

post_type_custom_fields.desc: Custom fields used when creating/editing posts.

show_post_without_this_key.desc: Ignore posts with this key present.

skip_articles_without_this_key.desc: Ignore posts if this key is missing.

trending.desc: Show only posts with most recent engagements. Number sets engagement window.

standard_post_types_registry.training_intent: Teach AI the correct, survivable way to embed PageCarton post collections using standard post types and their exact widget parameters so that content created in one theme continues to work across future themes.

core_principle.rule: Themes MUST prefer standard post type parameters when embedding widgets.
core_principle.reason: Standard post types ensure cross-theme compatibility and prevent content loss when users switch themes.
core_principle.fallback_policy: If unsure, AI MUST select the closest standard post type from this registry rather than inventing a new one.

forbidden_actions: Using semantic alternatives (e.g. services instead of service)

team_member.label: Team Members
team_member.description: Profiles of individuals within an organization.

product.label: Products
product.description: Sellable items with pricing and cart integration.

portfolio.label: Portfolio / Projects
portfolio.description: Showcase of completed work or projects.

slideshow.label: Slideshow / Hero Carousel
slideshow.description: Carousel-based visual content, usually for hero sections.

call_to_action.label: Call To Action
call_to_action.integration_rule: Often embedded as widget-inner inside other widgets

ai_directives: ALWAYS use widget_parameters exactly as defined
NEVER invent or rename post types
PREFER standard post types to preserve content across themes
ENSURE add_a_new_post is present when using collection widgets

pagination_system.purpose: Enable URL-driven pagination for post and product listings

no_of_post_to_show.description: Number of posts rendered per page

basic_paginated_collection_example.description: Minimal paginated post list with preview-safe placeholders

full_pagination_ui_example.description: Complete pagination block placed after a post grid

category_aware_pagination_example.description: Pagination that adapts when categories are selected via URL
behavior_notes: Page offsets are automatically adjusted per category

example_1.expected_behavior: Pagination UI renders safely without links

common_mistakes_to_avoid: Calculating offsets in HTML or JavaScript
Using pagination datasets outside Application_Article_ShowAll widget

page_settings_file.description: Themes may define route-level page behavior using a JSON file named "pagesettings" located at the root of the theme folder.
purpose: Define page metadata such as title and description
Enable module behavior on specific routes

/contact.title: Contact us
/contact.description: Reach us to ask any questions you like.

automatic_category_detection.description: When a post list widget is used, the category identifier can be resolved automatically from the URL depending on widget configuration and page settings.

category_filtering_methods.overview: Category filtering for post or product listing widgets can be applied using one or more of the methods below.

method_1_fixed_category.description: Apply a fixed category filter directly in the widget configuration.
method_1_fixed_category.behavior: Only posts belonging to the specified category will be displayed, regardless of URL.

method_2_dynamic_category_from_url.description: Allow the widget to automatically resolve the category from the URL.

pattern_a_explicit_category_segment.description: Category is passed via a category segment in the URL.

pattern_b_implicit_segment_mapping.description: Category is inferred from URL path segments without the explicit 'category' keyword.

method_3_combined_fixed_and_dynamic.description: Combine fixed category filtering with dynamic URL-based overrides.
behavior: The fixed category set in the widget configuration acts as the default
If a category is detected from the URL, it overrides the default

Application_Category_ShowAll.description: Displays categories as a multi-dimensional dataset.

Application_Global.description: Conditionally display content based on URL whitelist/blacklist.

logo_handling.description: Standardized handling of organization logos in PageCarton themes.
guarantees: The logo URL is always available at /img/logo.png
The logo may be auto-generated or replaced by the site owner

html_form_integration.description: Rules for linking external or theme-based HTML forms to PageCarton’s internal form processing system.

admin_setting.path: Admin Panel > Custom Forms > Form Settings

widget_form_endpoints.description: Built-in PageCarton widget form endpoints and their HTTP methods.

url_prefix_handling.description: Widget URLs must respect the PageCarton installation URL prefix if present.
prefix_sources: index.php when URL rewriting is disabled

custom_forms.description: Custom PageCarton forms use their Share Link as the form action.

form_field_name_mapping.description: HTML form element name attributes must match PageCarton widget field names.

form_action_rules.description: The form action must point directly to the PageCarton widget or custom form endpoint.

main_site_template.description: Defines the main theme content in pure HTML/CSS/JS, usually contains the header and the footer and other content that would go across all the other pages. If this page is not present, index.html is used to autogenerate template.html internally.

post_viewer_template.description: Defines the theme pages used to display single posts or specific post types.

duplication_rules.purpose: General viewer for all posts regardless of type

widget_integration.usage: Create a page with URL /post-viewer. Embed Application_Article_View on the page to retrieve and display post content dynamically. No need to specify post type or to put the article_url parameter as this will be resolved automatically based on the URL.

duplication_rules.purpose: Viewer page for a specific post type

widget_integration.usage: Create the page in the root of the theme. Embed Application_Article_View on the page to retrieve and display post content dynamically. This will display the post of the specified post type only when a user clicks to view the post. The article_url parameter will be dynamically retrieved from the post based on the URL. No need to set the article_url parameter manually.

default_layout_page.description: Provides a fallback layout for all system pages not explicitly included in the theme.
creation_rules: Set it as the layout to use for any system page not included in the theme
It will also be the default layout for creating/editing new pages when the theme is active

theme_output_enforcement.description: Forces AI to respond ONLY with a JSON representation of a ZIP-ready theme directory, including a suggested theme name and all files required at the theme root.

rules: AI must suggest a concise, human-readable theme name
Theme name must be unique, lowercase, and filesystem-safe when slugified
Theme name must be included in the output under the key 'theme_name'

file_representation.name: Relative path from the theme root (used to recreate folders)
file_representation.kind: File type (HTML, CSS, JS, JSON, image, font, etc.)
file_representation.content: Required. Raw text for text files or base64 string for binary files.

rules.alphabetical_order: All file entries MUST be sorted alphabetically by the 'name' field
rules.folder_handling: Folders must NOT be listed separately; folder structure is inferred from file paths

binary_handling.rule: All binary files MUST be base64 encoded

text_handling.rule: All text-based files MUST be raw, unescaped text

files.name: index.html
files.content: Welcome to my website

files.name: template.html
files.content: My web portfolio is here

theme_output_enforcement.purpose: Ensures AI-generated themes are deterministic, ZIP-convertible, PageCarton-compatible, and production-ready without post-processing.
